stories.title: The Clockmaker's Missing Minute
stories.synopsis: A missing watch, a staged blackout, and a detective who follows the evidence rather than the clock.

stories.title: The Garden That Remembered Rain
stories.synopsis: When a city loses its rain, two siblings follow the clues hidden in an extraordinary rooftop garden.

stories.title: The Last Signal from Orbit Nine
stories.synopsis: A junior satellite engineer receives a distress call from a spacecraft decommissioned years earlier.

stories.title: The Map of Forgotten Stations
stories.synopsis: A railway archivist finds a route that appears on no timetable, and discovers why a mountain town chose to vanish.

stories.title: The Violin in the Locked Room
stories.synopsis: An instrument disappears from a sealed rehearsal hall, leaving a melody that no one admits hearing.
